title: expand_url_template unmatched-brace error uses InvalidArgument instead of InvalidSession
description: In blob.rs, expand_url_template() returns ClientError::InvalidArgument("unmatched '{' in URL template") for a malformed URL template returned by the server. This is wrong: the template comes from Session.download_url / Session.upload_url (server-provided), not from the caller. A malformed server-supplied template is a parse/session error (ClientError::InvalidSession), not an argument error. InvalidArgument implies the caller did something wrong.
